config: - min_stmts: how short a repeated run may be before it is a violation; runs of fewer statements than this are ignored (default 2). - max_holes: how many holes a group may have and still be a violation; 0 means the copies must match exactly after renaming (default 4). - min_nodes_per_hole: how much shared structure each hole must have as a count of syntax nodes; groups below this are too small to be worth a parameter and are ignored (default 20). - ignore: list of group ids to skip (copy them from the violation report)
